kind: source optimisation inventory and controlled measurements

rows.name: native-i64
rows.mechanism: Fast safe integers use i128 intermediates and return native i64. The slow path converts to floating values, truncates/checks the result and reclassifies it. Both retain JavaScript integer semantics.
rows.qualification: Negative wall-time point estimate for this recursive workload. Do not call it a demonstrated speedup or general regression.

rows.name: tail-trace
rows.mechanism: A tail call replaces the current head trace instead of pushing another trace. Old immutable nodes still belong to the arena.
rows.qualification: No measured speedup here. Separate structural probe shows live trace length 2002 to1, but arena capacity stays6630200bytes.

rows.name: ir-pointer-identity
rows.mechanism: Closure equality returns equal when both IR object maps share their exact key-storage pointer and count, bypassing recursive IR structural equality.
rows.qualification: Favourable self-comparison workload with a 200-addition shared closure body. Different closure bodies still require structural comparison.

rows.name: static-builtin-map
rows.mechanism: Compile-time std.StaticStringMap replaces linear string comparisons over builtin names.
rows.qualification: Small median benefit in this arithmetic workload, slower p99. Do not claim universal improvement.

rows.name: release-fast-build
rows.mechanism: Zig ReleaseFast enables compiler optimisation and removes Debug runtime checks.
rows.qualification: Same source and full recursive evaluator workload, not TUI-dispatch timing or Android hardware.

rows.name: nonjoining-close
rows.mechanism: Retire IDs, atomically cancel active calls, let active owners free after return; dispose idle sessions on dedicated worker.
rows.qualification: NativeBackend deterministic 25ms release delay for active calls; deterministic 25ms destroy for idle cleanup. Actual production NativeSessions class vs a single-policy source ablation, runs on host JVM17 not Android.

rows.name: deferred-idle-free
rows.mechanism: Move idle arena destruction onto the disposer executor instead of blocking close.
rows.qualification: NativeBackend deterministic 25ms release delay for active calls; deterministic 25ms destroy for idle cleanup. Actual production NativeSessions class vs a single-policy source ablation, runs on host JVM17 not Android.

non_optimisation_features.reason: New callback execution mode with memory/step/input/output limits. Existing final host costs are not a before/after comparison.
Persisted source entrypoints and fresh sessions replace unsupported live-continuation persistence. No runtime speedup claim.
Prevent post-cancel effects and use-after-free. Close-call scheduling has separate quantified ablations.
No separate mobile language implementation or child-process execution in production, but no historical mobile-before runtime exists.
It precomputes invariant text, but no dynamic native dictionary predecessor exists. A fabricated dynamic baseline would not isolate an implemented optimisation.
No runtime speedup follows from the origin or export format of source code.

do_not_compare.reason: Host scheduling differs, and later features change source. Not an isolated optimisation.
Normal evaluator sources are unchanged; extra capabilities and measurement conditions differ.
